description_en: Modifies the configurations of a BGP group by calling the ModifyBgpGroupAttribute operation
description_zh: 调用ModifyBgpGroupAttribute接口修改BGP组的配置
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-bgp-group-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bgp-group-id bgpg-wz9f62v4fbg2g0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBgpGroupAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the BGP group. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
BGP组所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BGP group
parameters.name: bgp_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the BGP group. 

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
BGP组的名称。 

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the BGP group.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
BGP组的描述信息。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The custom Alibaba Cloud-side BGP autonomous system number (ASN). Valid values:

45104
64512 to 65534
4200000000 to 4294967294

65025 is reserved by Alibaba Cloud. The Alibaba Cloud side uses 45104 as the default LocalAsn value. Using a custom LocalAsn value in multi-ISP access scenarios may cause BGP routing loops. Evaluate the risks before you use this feature
parameters.help_zh:
自定义阿里云侧BGP AS号。取值：

45104
64512~65534
4200000000~4294967294

其中65025为阿里云保留值，阿里侧默认使用45104作为LocalAsn，使用自定义LocalAsn功能在多线接入场景时可能存在BGP路由环路风险，请合理评估后使用
parameters.name: local_asn

parameters.help_en: The ASN of the on-premises device
parameters.name: peer_asn

parameters.help_en: The authentication key of the BGP group
parameters.name: auth_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a fake ASN. Valid values:

false (default): No.
true: Yes.

A router that runs BGP can belong to only one AS. When you need to replace an existing AS with a new one (for example, during AS migration or merger with another AS) and cannot immediately modify the BGP configuration due to business constraints, you can specify a fake ASN to establish a connection with the local end to ensure service continuity
parameters.help_zh:
是否指定伪AS号。取值;

false（默认值）：否。
true：是。

运行BGP的路由器一般只能属于一个AS。当需要用新的AS替代原有的AS（例如AS需要迁移或者和其他AS合并），并且因为业务等客观因素无法立即修改BGP配置时，可以通过指定伪AS号与本端建立连接，保证业务不中断
parameters.name: is_fake_asn

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of routes for a BGP peer. Unit: entries. Default value: 110
parameters.help_zh: BGP邻居的路由条目上限。单位：条，默认值：110
parameters.name: route_quota

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to clear the authentication key. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false (default): No
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要清空密钥。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: clear_auth_key
